newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan shipbuilders rise on production plans.
newsitem.headline: Japan shipbuilders rise on production plans.

text.p: Japanese shipbuilders rose on Wednesday morning due to hopes that their plans to boost production capacity will lead to a rise in earnings, brokers said.
As of 0130 GMT, Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd was up five yen at 530. Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries Co Ltd rose 10 yen to reach 450.
Kawasaki Heavy said on Wednesday it plans to resume operating one of the shipbuilding slipways at its Kobe plant as early as the summer of 1998.
Ishikawajima-Harima also said it had boosted production capacity at its Tokyo plant to 26,500 tonnes from 25,500 tonnes.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily said on Wednesday that Japan's major shipbuilders are planning to boost production amid their rising international competitiveness.
